summary: In this tire-focused guide, Sue from 1A Auto explains how to read and interpret tire size codes, age, and proper maintenance to maximize safety and performance. The video covers decoding tire size (width, aspect ratio, radial construction, and rim diameter), understanding speed ratings, locating the official tire size on the door placard and the spare, and identifying tire age from the date code. It also demonstrates practical topics like tire pressure, using gauges, tread-depth checks (with gauges and the Lincoln penny method), and when to repair vs replace. The discussion extends to patching vs plugging, the importance of rotation, and the role of alignment for front-, rear-, and all-wheel-drive vehicles, including the need for four matching tires on AWD systems and seasonal considerations for snow tires. Practical buying guidance, maintenance cadence, and the rationale behind many recommendations are tied back to safety and performance considerations.
